sections.title: Using GrabFood in Thailand
paragraphs: GrabFood Thailand offers food and drink delivery as well as restaurant pickup. The restaurants you can order from depend on your chosen delivery location.
links: GrabFood registration, payments, hotel delivery and cancellations

sections.title: How to order food to your hotel
steps: Check the address and map pin
Make sure the hotel name, address and map pin match, then ask reception where to collect your order.
Choose your meal and order type
Select your food and options, and check whether you are ordering delivery or restaurant pickup.
Check the total and payment method
Check the final total, including food and delivery fees, before choosing a payment method.
Collect at the agreed location
Follow the instructions in the app and go to the collection point. Have the amount ready if you are paying cash.

sections.title: Delivery fees and payment methods
paragraphs: GrabFood’s official FAQ distinguishes food prices from delivery fees, which are calculated according to the distance between the restaurant and delivery location. Check the final amount on the order screen.

Cash, credit cards, debit cards and GrabPay are listed as payment methods. Check which ones your account can actually use. If you plan to pay cash with a large banknote, tell the rider through the app’s chat.

sections.title: Ordering late at night
paragraphs: The service’s operating hours and individual restaurant opening hours are different. Closed restaurants cannot accept orders in the app, so check which places can deliver to your current location and their estimated delivery times.

sections.title: Order enquiries and refunds
paragraphs: Keep your order history and contact support through the relevant order. Cancellation and refund conditions depend on the service and the status of the order.

sections.title: LINE MAN food delivery
paragraphs: Set your delivery address in Thailand to explore LINE MAN. With your hotel address selected, you can see available restaurants and delivery fees.
The app combines food delivery, ride booking and everyday essentials. Have your LINE ID ready and select the food delivery menu.

sections.title: ShopeeFood delivery
paragraphs: Set your delivery address in the app to explore ShopeeFood. Select your hotel address to see available restaurants and delivery fees.
Order through the ShopeeFood menu in the Thai Shopee app. Food delivery is separate from shipping shopping purchases. The Thai Shopee app lists Thai, English and Burmese language support.

sections.title: Robinhood food delivery
paragraphs: Robinhood serves Bangkok and nearby areas. Set your hotel address to see which restaurants can deliver there and how much delivery costs.
The operator’s official app description covers restaurants in Bangkok and nearby areas. Check which restaurants deliver to your current location.

faq: Can food be delivered to my hotel room?
That depends on the hotel’s collection rules. Ask reception where to collect your food.
Can I pay cash?
The official FAQ lists cash payments. Check the methods actually available on your order screen.
What is the difference between delivery and pickup?
Delivery brings food to your chosen address. For pickup, you collect it yourself at the selected restaurant.

grabfood.title: GrabFood Thailand | Registration, foreign cards, hotel delivery and cancellations
grabfood.name: GrabFood in Thailand
grabfood.intro: Use the Food menu in the Grab app when you want a meal delivered to your hotel. This guide covers choosing a delivery location, cash and foreign-card payments, cancellations, and the documented registration steps for a South Korean phone number.
summary: Restaurants available at your delivery address
Grab app → Food → choose address and food
Check food prices, delivery fees and foreign-payment fees

sections.title: Registering with a South Korean phone number
paragraphs: Grab Thailand’s help page says verification codes for South Korean numbers are sent by SMS. If you use a South Korean number, select South Korea as the country code and enter a mobile number that can receive texts. Enter the 6-digit code to continue registration.

If the text does not arrive, check your phone’s message filters and mobile network connection. A travel data-only line does not replace SMS reception on your existing South Korean number, so check that number’s text-message settings too.

sections.title: How to order food to your hotel
steps: Select Food and your delivery address
Open Food in Grab and match the hotel address to the map pin. Available restaurants and delivery times depend on this address.
Choose food and options
Select dishes, quantities and extras, and check whether the order is for delivery or restaurant pickup.
Check the total and payment method
Open Payment details in your basket, then See all to choose a payment method. Review food prices, delivery fees, discount conditions and charges before tapping Place Order.
Meet the rider at the collection point
Ask reception where food deliveries should be collected, then agree the location with the rider in the app. Room delivery depends on hotel rules. Have the order amount ready if paying cash.

sections.title: Cash, foreign cards, KakaoPay and fees
paragraphs: Grab Thailand lists cash and credit or debit cards issued in Thailand or abroad. KakaoPay is also among the official payment methods. Check the payment screen for the options available to your own account and order.

Payments with foreign cards or foreign e-wallets carry a foreign-payment fee of 3% of the total transaction, with a minimum of 1 baht. Fractions of 0.5 baht or more round up; smaller fractions round down. Your card issuer may also charge its own overseas transaction fee.
The payment method from your most recent ride or order may be selected by default, so review it before ordering. Grab says splitting payment between GrabPay and cash is not supported.

sections.title: How do I request a cancellation?
steps: Open your order history
In Activity, select the food order you want to cancel.
Select Get Help
Tap Get Help at the top right of the order screen. Cancel order appears if the order is eligible for cancellation.
Check the cancellation result
After requesting cancellation, look for a success notification. Pressing the button alone does not mean the order has been cancelled.
paragraphs: The official guidance describes cancellation as more likely to be approved if the restaurant has not accepted the order, if it is delayed by more than 15 minutes without an assigned rider, or if it is delayed by more than 30 minutes while the food is still at the restaurant.

Cancellation may be difficult once delivery has started or the order is complete. For a group order, the person who created it must request cancellation. An order is not always free to cancel simply because a rider has not yet been assigned.

sections.title: Missing or incorrect food
paragraphs: Keep your order history and photos of the food, packaging and receipt. Report the problem through Get Help on that order, and check its guidance for refund approval and progress.
links: GrabFood help for missing or incorrect items

faq: Can I register for GrabFood Thailand with a South Korean number?
Grab Thailand’s help page says the verification code for a South Korean number is sent by SMS. Make sure that number can receive texts.
Can I use a foreign card or KakaoPay on GrabFood Thailand?
The official payment options include foreign credit and debit cards and KakaoPay. Check availability on your order. Foreign cards and e-wallets carry a 3% fee, with a minimum of 1 baht.
Will the food come to my hotel room?
That depends on hotel rules. Ask reception where to collect food, then agree the location with the rider through the app.
Is cancellation always free before a rider is assigned?

No. Open the order in Activity, choose Get Help → Cancel order, and look for a success notification. The official guidance also considers restaurant acceptance and how long the order has been delayed.
